Kept apart from B's CM-CAT-010 (sourcing by dropshipping apps, which cites SA-C-124's category and endpoint as extension-point), F's CM-APP-003 (the platform billing the merchant for an app) and A's CM-PLN-006 (the store balance itself). No parent: the wallet it withholds from is domain A's.

capability: Payment links: a link to pay for an order that the merchant sends the buyer (Salla إرسال رابط الدفع للعميل)
note: Salla gives it a plan line of its own (SA-S-1968, in its payment group) and sends the link from the order's actions (SA-S-5143); under CM-ORD-001 by that admin place, a reading. Shopify's draft orders' invoices (SH-S-7225, CM-ORD-008) aren't stated to carry a link to pay (U-018, apart).

capability: Taxes on the store's sales: the store's tax settings, the taxes and rates it charges its buyers and how its prices show them (Shopify Taxes and duties, MANAGE_TAXES_SETTINGS, read_taxes; Salla Taxes / الضرائب, Tax settings / إعدادات الضريبة, tax_management, taxes, ضريبة القيمة المضافة)
note: Q1's M-040 (SH-C-100, SA-C-160). Both give it a place of its own: Shopify's settings section Taxes and duties at /settings/taxes (SH-S-1492, SH-S-7123), its staff permission and its scopes read_taxes and write_taxes; Salla's settings link Taxes at /taxes-and-duties (SA-S-1686), its Tax settings at /payments/taxes (SA-S-1879), its Merchant API folder Taxes, its scope taxes and its staff permission tax_management. It is the parent of the TAX area: Shopify puts registrations, VAT validation, tax providers and duties under the same Taxes section (paths add, ioss, vat-number-validation, providers, duties: SH-S-7124 to SH-S-7129), and Salla's one link is Taxes and duties. Not A's CM-PLN-007, the taxes on the platform's own charges to the merchant: there Shopify's "Tax registration" is the merchant's tax ID for Shopify's bills (SH-S-0279), a homonym of the store's registrations to collect tax (CM-TAX-003).

capability: The platform's automated tax calculation service: the platform works out the sales tax and VAT on the store's orders and keeps the rates current (Shopify Tax, Automated sales tax calculations, shopifyTax)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the plan line Automated sales tax calculations (SH-S-7066), the store entitlement shopifyTax, the built-in features pages Shopify Tax (EU, UK, US) and its own terms (www.shopify.com/legal/shopify-tax-terms). Under CM-TAX-001 by Shopify's grouping: the Taxes settings route is gated by the entitlement shopifyTax.enabled (SH-S-5271), and SH-C-100 holds both the default rates and Shopify Tax. WooCommerce's split (WC-C-054, merchant-entered rates; WC-C-055, WooCommerce Tax) is the same cut (M-040's granularity).

capability: Tax registrations: the store's registrations with the tax authorities where it must collect tax, the tax number it records and shows, and tracking where it is liable (Shopify Tax registrations, add-registration, IOSS registration, Tax liability tracking; Salla الرقم الضريبي, التسجيل في هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the Taxes section's routes add (add-registration) and ioss (SH-S-7124, SH-S-7125) and the plan line Tax liability tracking (SH-S-7067). Q1 split SH-C-101 from calculation "because the merchant decides where it is registered while Shopify computes". Under CM-TAX-001 by Shopify's paths in its Taxes section. Homonym: Shopify's "Tax registration" for Shopify's own bills (SH-S-0279) is A's CM-PLN-007.

capability: Third-party tax services: tax apps and providers that calculate the store's taxes in place of the platform's own (Shopify Tax apps, tax_calculation, Manage tax provider, tax_services/create, write_taxes, Advanced tax platform; Salla avalara-tax)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the App Store category Tax apps (SH-S-2708), the extension point tax_calculation (SH-S-2256), the Taxes section's route providers, "Manage tax provider" (SH-S-7127), and the plan line Advanced tax platform (SH-S-7069). Under CM-TAX-001 by Shopify's own route (Taxes > providers) and because a tax app "replaces Shopify's tax service for that store" (SH-S-0530).

capability: VAT number validation, tax exemptions and VAT invoices: business buyers enter a VAT number that is validated to claim the reverse charge exemption, buyers are exempted from tax, and the VAT invoices that follow (Shopify VAT validation, exemptions, and invoicing; VAT validation in checkout)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the plan line "VAT validation, exemptions, and invoicing" (SH-S-7068) and the Taxes section's route vat-number-validation (SH-S-7126). One capability at Shopify's grain: its plan line holds the three together, and its help centre puts VAT validation and VAT invoices under "Shopify Tax features for the European Union and United Kingdom" (SH-I-2330). Under CM-TAX-001 by Shopify's route. Not C's CM-ORD-008: that is the order's invoice as the store issues and prints it; what is here is the VAT treatment Shopify Tax applies.

capability: Automated tax filing: the store's sales tax returns prepared, filed and remitted through the platform (Shopify Tax Automated Filing, Automated filing, taxes/filing, taxFilingEnabled)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the admin route taxes/filing (SH-S-5269), the billing charge category Automated filing (SH-I-1324), its own terms (Shopify Tax Automated Filing Terms of Service, SH-S-0040). Under CM-TAX-002 by Shopify's grouping: "Automated filing with Shopify Tax", available only for stores in the United States that use Shopify Tax (SH-S-0522). Closed to new enrollment and ending for sales after December 31, 2026 (SH-S-0521, SH-S-0525). Not the same thing as Salla's e-invoicing with ZATCA (CM-TAX-007): a return is filed for a period's sales; an e-invoice is reported invoice by invoice (U-031, apart).

capability: E-invoicing with the tax authority: the store's tax invoices linked and uploaded electronically to the tax authority through the platform (Salla الربط مع هيئة الزكاة والضريبة, الربط بهيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك, zatca)
note: Salla gives it a place of its own: an app installed from its app store, الربط مع هيئة الزكاة والضريبة (SA-S-0151), the released flag zatca of type app (SA-S-3219) and the plan line الربط بهيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك (SA-S-2120, سلة برو). For stores in Saudi Arabia only (SA-S-0149). Q1 split SA-C-161 from Salla's taxes per market and from order invoices (SA-C-044, C's CM-ORD-008). No parent: no statement held puts it under Salla's tax settings or its invoice settings (the plan line's parent_code mhfth-almtgr-oalfotr has no title held). Not Shopify's automated filing (CM-TAX-006) nor its VAT invoices (CM-TAX-005): U-031, apart.

capability: Duties and import taxes on cross-border orders: estimating, collecting and settling the customs duties and import taxes on what the store ships abroad (Shopify Duties and import taxes, Estimate and collect duties and taxes, Duty; Salla الرسوم الجمركية, إظهار حقل المعلومات الجمركية)
note: Q1's M-042 (SH-C-105, SA-C-162). Shopify gives it a place of its own: the Taxes section's route duties (SH-S-7129), the plan line Estimate and collect duties and taxes (SH-S-7079), the Admin API object Duty (SH-S-7456) and its billing charge categories. Under CM-TAX-001 by both platforms' grouping: Shopify's Taxes and duties settings, Salla's link Taxes at /taxes-and-duties. A merchant of record that handles duties for the store, such as Shopify's Managed Markets, is E's CM-MKS-003; product customs data for shipping (Salla SA-C-146, HS codes) is the SHP batch's.

capability: Tax forms the platform issues to the merchant: the tax documents the platform files with the tax authority about the merchant's receipts and gives the merchant (Shopify 1099-K and 1099-MISC tax forms, VIEW_TAX_DOCUMENTS)
note: Shopify gives it a place of its own: the admin routes finance/tax-forms/1099-k and finance/tax-forms/1099-misc (SH-S-7121, SH-S-7122) and the staff permission VIEW_TAX_DOCUMENTS. The forms report the merchant's receipts: the 1099-K "is generated by Shopify Payments and is provided to you and to the IRS annually" (SH-S-0505). Not A's CM-PLN-007 (taxes on Shopify's charges) nor CM-PAY-002: the payment service is the filer, the forms are a tax document. The routes are in the admin section Banking (C's CM-PAY-023), but no statement puts the forms under it, so no parent. Scope: United States.

capability: Shipping and delivery: the store's shipping setup, the zones it ships to and the rates its buyers pay, set in the platform's shipping settings (Shopify Shipping and delivery, shipping profiles, Shipping and fulfillment, read_shipping; Salla Shipping & delivery, Shipping settings, Shipping Zones, shippings, تخصيص تسعيرة الشحن)
note: Q1's M-045 (SH-C-114, SA-C-142, WC-C-075). The area's parent: both platforms put the area's other subjects under it. Shopify's routes for carrier services, order routing, local delivery and pickup in store are paths of its section Shipping (SH-S-7133, SH-S-7140, SH-S-7136, SH-S-7137), and its store entitlement shipping holds both settingsAccess and labels (SH-S-5842). Salla's plan lines for its own labels, branch pickup and rates share the parent_code alshhn-oaltosyl (SA-S-2018, SA-S-2029, SA-S-2023), and its Shipment log sits in the same admin list (list 8) as Shipping & delivery and Shipping settings (SA-S-1871, SA-S-1868). Both API groupings put fulfilment with shipping: Shopify's resource group Shipping and fulfillment (SH-S-0786), Salla's developer section Shipments & Fulfillment APIs (SA-S-1171). Salla's shipping restrictions (قيود الشحن والتوصيل; shipping_rules_management, قيود شركات الشحن; restrict-shipping-companies-by-country) are cited here: no statement held defines them, so they are not joined with Shopify's delivery customization (CM-SHP-013). Homonym: Shopify's route shipping-calculator (SH-S-5262, here) and Salla's plan line حاسبة تكلفة الشحن (SA-S-2024, CM-SHP-002), each undefined. Customer addresses are D's CM-CUS-008.

capability: Shipping labels bought through the platform: the merchant buys and prints carriers' shipping labels in the admin, at the platform's rates, and pays for them through its account with the platform (Shopify Shipping, Shipping labels, Buy and print shipping labels; Salla بوليصات سلة, بوليصات شحن سلة المُخفضة, Shipping label cost deduction)
note: Q1's M-047 (SH-C-116, SA-C-140, WC-C-060): "Each is the platform's own label-buying service with integrated carriers." Under CM-SHP-001 by both platforms' grouping: Shopify's entitlement shipping holds labels beside settingsAccess (SH-S-5842); Salla's plan line sits under alshhn-oaltosyl (SA-S-2018). Both say the carrier, not the platform, carries: Shopify "serves only as an intermediary" between the merchant and the Third-Party Integrator or Third-Party Shipping Provider (SH-S-0613); Salla's labels follow the approved carriers' cancellation and return policies (SA-S-5060). Homonym: بوليصة (policy) is Salla's word for a shipping label, an air waybill (AWB), not a store policy (E's CM-CNT-008). The merchant's own carrier account used with the platform's labels (Shopify SH-S-0616) is cited here; Salla's own-contract carriers (SA-C-141) are batch 11's. Customs fees on Salla's labels (SA-S-5075) are core in CM-TAX-008, shows here.

capability: Shipping insurance: insurance on a shipment sent with the platform's shipping labels (Shopify Shipping insurance, Third-Party Shipping Insurance)
note: Shopify gives it a plan line, Shipping insurance*, included on every plan (SH-S-7047), and a billing charge category Insurance premiums (SH-I-1331). Under CM-SHP-002 by Shopify's own words: "If you ship orders from the United States and you buy shipping labels, then you can protect your orders by purchasing shipping insurance" (SH-S-0720), and "Labels from Shopify include ... up to $200 insurance" (SH-S-7220). Homonym: تأمين in Salla's packaging statement (SA-S-5069) is securing packaging, not insurance.

capability: Third-party calculated shipping rates: shipping rates shown to the buyer that a carrier or an app's carrier service calculates, in place of the merchant's own rates (Shopify 3rd-party calculated shipping rates, CarrierService, DeliveryCarrierService, Shipping rate apps, Manage preferred carriers)
note: Shopify gives it a plan line (SH-S-7048: not included on Basic, an add-on on Grow, included on Advanced and Plus), a route in its section Shipping (carrier-services/:id, Manage preferred carriers, SH-S-7133), the API resource CarrierService and an App Store category Shipping rate apps (SH-S-2629); hence under CM-SHP-001. No statement held says how the rates are calculated beyond the plan line's name. Q1's U-072 sets SH-C-115 among Salla's carriers and shipping apps (SA-C-139, SA-C-141, SA-C-145), which land in batch 11.

capability: Order routing: rules that assign an order to the locations that fulfil it (Shopify Order routing, Order Routing Location Rule, fulfillment_orders/order_routing_complete)
note: You can set up order routing to automatically assign orders to fulfillment locations based on configured rules (SH-S-0751). Under CM-SHP-001 by Shopify's route order_routing in its section Shipping (SH-S-7140). Apps write rules through the Function API Order Routing Location Rule. Not B's CM-INV-009 (inventory withdrawal priority), whose Shopify cell is none-held and whose Salla cell holds Branch and warehouse priority order (SA-S-1755); not C's CM-ORD-007 (assignment to staff); not G's CM-OPS-001, which cites Salla's automatic assignment of an order to the next carrier by priority (SA-S-0162). Locations are B's CM-INV-005. Salla's Shipping Routes (SA-C-143, U-020) are batch 11's: no statement held defines them.

capability: Local pickup and local delivery: getting an order to a buyer near the store's own locations, by the buyer's pickup or the store's own delivery (Shopify Local pickup, Local delivery; Salla الاستلام من الفرع, Branch Delivery Zones)
note: Q1's M-046 (SH-C-121, SA-C-148): each platform's concern holds both. A parent at their grain, with a child for each (CM-SHP-007, CM-SHP-008), since Shopify gives each a route of its own (SH-S-7137, SH-S-7136) and Salla gives pickup a plan line and local delivery an API folder. Under CM-SHP-001: Shopify's routes are in its section Shipping; Salla's pickup plan line is under alshhn-oaltosyl (SA-S-2029). Homonym: الفرع in Salla's economy shipping "(استلام وتسليم من الفرع)" (SA-S-2020, CM-SHP-002) is a carrier's branch, not the store's; Shopify's pickup points (SH-C-124, batch 11) are a carrier's too.

capability: Local pickup: the buyer collects the order at one of the store's locations (Shopify Pickup in store, Local pick up, product pickup locations; Salla إتاحة الاستلام من الفرع)
note: Shopify's route pickup_in_store (SH-S-7137), its webhook topic fulfillment_orders/line_items_prepared_for_pickup and the Storefront scope unauthenticated_read_product_pickup_locations; Salla's plan line إتاحة الاستلام من الفرع (Salla Plus, SA-S-2029). Neither platform defines it beyond its name in what is held.

capability: Local delivery: the store's own delivery of orders to buyers near its locations (Shopify Local delivery; Salla Branch Delivery Zones)
note: Shopify's route local_deliveries (SH-S-7136) and its webhook topic fulfillment_orders/line_items_prepared_for_local_delivery; Salla's Merchant API folder Branch Delivery Zones (SA-S-1071). Neither defines it beyond its name in what is held: that Salla's branch delivery zones are the store's own delivery, as Shopify's local delivery is, is Q1's match M-046, a reading.

capability: Order fulfilment: sending an order's items to the buyer, recorded on the order as fulfillments or shipments (Shopify Fulfillment orders, fulfillments, Fulfill and ship, FulfillmentOrder; Salla Shipments, Shipment log, order.shipment.created)
note: Q1's M-048 (SH-C-118, WC-C-092); U-073 sets SH-C-118 and SH-C-126 against Salla's Shipments (SA-C-144) and shipping apps (SA-C-145), which land in batch 11. Salla's cell is a join on role (a reading): Shopify's permission names the act Fulfill and ship (SH-S-6169, the user's fulfill_and_ship_orders), and Salla's shipments are created and cancelled for an order (order.shipment.created, order.shipment.cancelled) and first updated by the carrier (SA-S-1637). Under CM-SHP-001 by the grouping both share: Shopify's API group Shipping and fulfillment (SH-S-0786) and Salla's Shipment log in its shipping list (SA-S-1871); Shopify's staff permission also puts it under Orders. C's CM-ORD-009 (packing slips) may belong under it (notes).

capability: Fulfillment batching: the admin section Batches, open to stores eligible for fulfillment batching (Shopify Batches, fulfillmentBatchingEligible)
note: Shopify gives it an admin section of its own (section Batches, path batches, SH-S-7134), gated by the permission ORDERS and the store feature fulfillmentBatchingEligible (SH-S-7135), false in the captured trial stores and true in the development stores (SH-S-5792, SH-S-5794); hence under CM-SHP-009 by the feature's name. No statement held says what a batch holds. Salla's plan line إدارة مجموعة طلبات كدفعة واحدة (managing a group of orders as one batch, SA-S-1996) is C's CM-ORD-001: nothing held ties it to fulfilment.

capability: Fulfillment services and third-party logistics: an app or provider that stores the merchant's stock and prepares and ships its orders, taking the orders to fulfil from the platform (Shopify Fulfillment services, FulfillmentService, Third-party logistics (3PL) apps; Salla Fulfillment apps)
note: Shopify: "Fulfillment service apps provide third-party warehousing, print on demand, or fulfillment services that prepare and ship orders on behalf of merchants" (SH-S-0702); they "can accept or reject requests to fulfill orders" (SH-S-0704), on the fulfillment orders their scopes reach (SH-S-5934), hence under CM-SHP-009. Its App Store category Third-party logistics (3PL) apps (SH-S-2631) and billing category External 3PL transaction fees (SH-I-1329). Salla's app category Fulfillment (SA-S-1192) is read as the same role (a reading), with its unreleased flag shipping-fulfillment-centers. A fulfillment service's location is B's CM-INV-005 (SH-S-0703); dropshipping and print on demand as sourcing are B's CM-CAT-010.

capability: Fulfillment network offered in the platform's admin: one service that connects the merchant with logistics providers that store its stock and fulfil its orders (Shopify Fulfillment Network, Shopify Logistics)
note: You can use the Fulfillment Network to connect with third-party logistics providers (3PLs) that store your inventory and fulfill orders on your behalf (SH-S-0715), hence under CM-SHP-011. Shopify gives it an admin section (ShopifyFulfillmentNetwork, SH-S-1603), its own terms of service (SH-I-1390) and billing charge categories (SH-I-1347 to SH-I-1349, Shopify Logistics among them). It is installed from the Shopify App Store (SH-S-0716), and its route is gated by the apps permission (SH-S-5095). No statement held names Shopify's company as its maker (a gap), so the cell is not own-service.

capability: Delivery customization: app-written rules that change the delivery options a buyer is offered at checkout (Shopify Delivery Customization, a Shopify Function API, read_delivery_customizations)
note: Shopify's Function API Delivery Customization (SH-S-0855, target delivery_customization) with its scopes, and its help-centre section Customizing payment methods and delivery options at checkout (SH-I-2119). No parent, as batch 1's function capabilities (CM-CHK-005, -006): Shopify lists it among its Function APIs, and no admin route of it is held. No statement held says what a rule can do to an option. Salla's shipping restrictions (قيود الشحن والتوصيل) are in CM-SHP-001: with neither side defined, a join on role would rest on names only. F's CM-APP-005 holds functions as such; payment methods' counterpart is CM-PAY-019.

capability: Fulfillment constraints: rules an app's function sets on how orders are fulfilled (Shopify Fulfillment Constraints, a Shopify Function API, read_fulfillment_constraint_rules)
note: Shopify's Function API Fulfillment Constraints (SH-S-0857, target fulfillment_constraints), its scopes and the mutation fulfillmentConstraintRuleCreate, which the app that deployed the function invokes to register the rule (SH-S-6204). No statement held says what a constraint does: the name is Shopify's. No parent, as CM-SHP-013.

capability: Shipping carriers: the shipping companies a store ships with, connected in the platform's admin, whether under the platform's contracts or the merchant's own carrier account or contract (Salla Shipping Companies, شركات الشحن, ربط خاص بـ 190+ شركة شحن, ربط عقد ... الخاص بك, shipping.company.created; Shopify supported carriers, own Third-Party Shipping Provider account, Tracking carriers)
note: Salla gives it places of its own: its Merchant API folder Shipping Companies (SA-S-1045) with the topics shipping.company.created, .updated and .deleted, the plan lines ربط خاص بـ 190+ شركة شحن and شحن محلي وعالمي مع أكثر من 100 شركة شحن, its app type Shipping App "for shipping companies" (SA-S-1185) and one released feature flag per integrated carrier. Q1 split SA-C-139 (carriers named in flags and plan lines, "a flag or plan line naming a carrier does not say under whose contract the carrier" works) from SA-C-141 (the merchant's own carriers and contracts); both land here, the contract being a grain inside one capability, since no place of its own is held for either side of the split (notes, batch 11). Under CM-SHP-001 by both platforms' grouping: Salla's carriers are in its Shipping & delivery section and its plan lines share the parent_code alshhn-oaltosyl; Shopify's carrier account is connected "with Shopify Shipping" (SH-S-0616). The labels bought at the platform's rates through these carriers are CM-SHP-002. Homonym: Salla's flag track (SA-S-3081) is a carrier's name among the carriers' flags, not tracking (CM-SHP-017).

capability: Shipping routes: the section Shipping Routes of the platform's shipping settings (Salla Shipping Routes, shipping-routes)
note: Salla gives it a place of its own: the admin link Shipping Routes at /shipping/setting/routes (SA-S-1872), a Merchant API folder Shipping Routes beside Shipping Zones and Shipping Companies (SA-S-1047) and another in its shipping apps' APIs (SA-S-1118), and the released flag shipping-routes (plans pro and special). No statement held says what a route is: Q1's unclear candidate U-020 reads them as "routing to carriers", a reading not stated. Not Shopify's order routing (CM-SHP-005), which assigns orders to fulfillment locations (U-020, apart). Under CM-SHP-001 by its path in Salla's shipping settings.

capability: Shipment tracking: the tracking of an order's shipment, its tracking information and the carriers it can name, shown to the merchant and the buyer (Shopify Order tracking, FulfillmentTrackingInfo, Tracking carriers, Order tracking apps; Salla تتبع الطلب عبر محفظة أبل (Apple Wallet))
note: Shopify gives it places of its own: the App Store category Order tracking apps (SH-S-2620), its built-in feature Order tracking, at the customer notifications settings with surface_detail=order-tracking (SH-S-7208), and the Admin API object FulfillmentTrackingInfo; Salla a plan line, تتبع الطلب عبر محفظة أبل (Apple Wallet), Salla Plus (SA-S-1995, SA-C-040's, left here by batch 2). Under CM-SHP-009 by Shopify's object, "the tracking information for a fulfillment" (SH-S-7459); Salla's line is in its plan group order management (parent_code adar-altlbat), and Salla's shipments concern (SA-C-144, in CM-SHP-009) names tracking in Q1's name only. The customer notifications that carry a shipping update are D's CM-NTF-001.

capability: Delivery promises: the delivery promises the store makes, with their settings (Shopify delivery promises, delivery_promise_settings/update, shop-promise-examples; Salla Shipping Delivery Promises, delivery-promises)
note: Q1's M-049 (SH-C-125, SA-C-147). Shopify gives it a route of its own in section Shipping, shop-promise-examples, open to a beta (SH-S-7139, SH-S-5033), its scopes read_ and write_delivery_promises and the topic delivery_promise_settings/update; Salla its Merchant API folder Shipping Delivery Promises, beside Shipping Zones (SA-S-1052), and an unreleased flag delivery-promises (plans pro and special). Neither platform defines a delivery promise in what is held. Under CM-SHP-001 by both platforms' grouping: Shopify's section Shipping, Salla's Merchant API folders of shipping. SA-C-147 lands in batch 12.

capability: Delivery option generators and shipping to pickup points: app-written functions that generate delivery options for checkout, among them pickup points and local pickup, and the admin's setting for shipping to pickup points (Shopify Pickup point delivery option generator, Local pickup delivery option generator, Fulfillment option generator, Shipping to pickup points)
note: Shopify gives it places of its own: the route pickup_points, titled Shipping to pickup points, in section Shipping (SH-S-7138), and the Function API targets local_pickup_delivery_option_generator and pickup_point_delivery_option_generator with the scope write_delivery_option_generators. Under CM-SHP-001 by that route's section. Nothing held defines a pickup point, or says whose location it is; the store's own pickup locations are CM-SHP-007. The function mechanism is F's CM-APP-005, as for CM-SHP-013 and CM-SHP-014.

capability: International shipping readiness and customs data: preparing products and shipments to be shipped abroad, with their customs code (HS code) and weight, and the platform's fee on international shipping (Salla International Shipping Readiness, international-product, كود التنسيق الجمركي للمنتج - HS code, رسوم بوابة الشحن الدولي; Shopify International shipping)
note: Salla gives it a place of its own: the admin link International Shipping Readiness at /shipping/international, in the same admin list as Shipping & delivery (SA-S-1873), with the released flag international-product. Under CM-SHP-001 by that path. Not CM-TAX-008 (duties and import taxes): SA-C-146's statements name a code that identifies shipments for export (SA-S-0167) and Salla's own service fee on international shipping (SA-S-0163), not duties or import taxes; the customs duties on Salla's labels (SA-S-5075) and the customs information field (SA-S-5074) stay in CM-TAX-008. Shopify's side is only its help-centre section International shipping (SH-I-2158).

capability: Packaging: packaging materials the merchant requests from the approved carriers through the platform's shipping section (Salla Packaging, طلب مواد التغليف, shipments-packaging-system)
note: Salla only so far: its admin link Packaging at /shipping/packing, in the list of Shipping & delivery (list 8, with /shipping, /shipping/logs and /shipping/international), and the released flag shipments-packaging-system. Under CM-SHP-001 by that grouping. Not CM-ORD-009 (Shopify's packing slips, a printed order document) and not CM-SHP-003: تأمين in "يمكنك تأمين تغليف احترافي" (SA-S-5069) is securing packaging, not insurance (batch 10's homonym). No statement held says which carriers supply the materials, or whether they are charged.

capability: Shipping complaints and carrier ratings: the merchant's complaints about the carriers of the platform's shipping labels, raised through the platform and escalated to it, and the carriers' ratings (Salla Quality gateway / بوابة الجودة, shipping-ticket-system, shipping-rating, الاطلاع على تقييمات شركات الشحن)
note: Salla only so far. Its definition: "نظام لإدارة ومتابعة شكاوي شركات شحن بوليصات سلة" (SA-S-5070), so under CM-SHP-002, the labels bought through the platform. Salla's plan line بوابة الجودة sits in the plan group alshhn-oaltosyl (shipping and delivery, SA-S-2025) and the link's path is /shipping/tickets, while the link itself is in Salla's admin list 7, beside Reviews & questions, Self-service system and Complaints. Kept apart (caps searched in every domain): D's CM-SUP-008 (the buyer's complaints about the store) and CM-SUP-005 (support tickets), A's CM-TRU-012 (merchants' complaints about the platform's own services) and CM-TRU-020 (buyers' complaints, Salla as mediator), and D's CM-SUP-001 (reviews and ratings of products): here the complaint is the merchant's, about a carrier, and the carrier answers it first. Who rates the carriers isn't stated.

capability: Returns and refunds: the store's handling of an order's returns and refunds, in the admin's orders (Shopify Orders > Returns and refunds; Salla إدارة طلبات الاسترجاع الجزئي والكلي)
note: Q1's M-024 is a difference of grain: Shopify splits refunds (SH-C-057, CM-RET-002) from returns and exchanges (SH-C-058, CM-RET-003); Salla's SA-C-045 holds both and lands here. Parent CM-ORD-001 by the grouping both platforms share: Shopify's routes Refund and Return and exchange sit in its admin section Orders (SH-S-7097, SH-S-7098) and its staff permissions under Orders > Returns and refunds (SH-I-0883); Salla's plan line sits in its plan group order management (adar-altlbat, SA-S-1998) and its setting Manage refund statuses under orders/ (SA-S-1743). The money side of Salla's refund, its Transactions endpoint, is also core in CM-PAY-020 (refund, void and reverse); a refund to store credit is D's CM-LOY-001; cancelling an order is CM-ORD-004; the store's return policy page is E's CM-CNT-008. Homonym: Salla's استرجاع and its slug restore name a return (مسترجع, restored, SA-S-2680), while its restore-data (CM-ORD-012) restores deleted orders.

capability: Refunds: returning an order's amount to the buyer, to the original payment or to store credit (Shopify Refund, refunds/create, REFUND_ORDERS, Refund to original payment; Salla order.refunded / إرجاع مبلغ الطلب, order_refund_payment / إمكانية إرجاع الطلبات, Manage refund statuses)
note: Shopify's admin route Refund (:orderId/refund, section Orders) and Salla's setting Manage refund statuses (orders/control-refund). Joined by Q1's M-024 (term and identifier: refunds/create, order.refunded). Salla's refund endpoint on a transaction (SA-S-0180) names refund, void and reverse: core here for the refund and in CM-PAY-020 for acting on the transaction. Shopify's refund to store credit (SH-I-0887) is core in D's CM-LOY-001 and shows here.

capability: Returns and exchanges: the buyer's return of an order's items, from the return request to the return shipment, and exchanges (Shopify Return and exchange, Return, returns/request, RETURN_ORDERS, Return reasons, reverse deliveries; Salla شحنة استرجاع, order.shipment.return.created, the order statuses مسترجع and قيد الإسترجاع)
note: Shopify gives it admin routes (Return and exchange, Review return request, section Orders), a staff permission, an API object and scopes, webhook topics and an App Store category; Salla shows it by its return shipment events (order.shipment.return.created, .creating, .cancelled) and its order statuses for returned orders. Return shipments are kept inside it: neither platform gives them a place of their own (only webhook topics: Shopify's reverse_deliveries and reverse_fulfillment_orders, Salla's order.shipment.return.*). Salla's return shipment topics are also SA-C-144's: core here, shows in CM-SHP-009. Homonym: exchange here is an item exchanged on a return, not E's exchange rates (CM-MKS-007) or Salla's loyalty reward exchange (salla-reward-exchange).

capability: Order withdrawal requests: the buyer's request, through the store, to withdraw from an order, which the merchant reviews (WooCommerce Order withdrawal, order_withdrawal, /my-account/withdraw-order/, Order withdrawal request)
note: Only WooCommerce shows it so far: a form in the buyer's account (/my-account/withdraw-order/, WC-S-5438), a feature that turns it on (order_withdrawal, WC-S-5440), and a customer and a staff email (WC-S-0314, WC-S-0315). Not CM-RET-003: no statement held says a withdrawal returns an order's items or refunds it, and WooCommerce 'does not determine whether the customer has a legal right to withdraw' (WC-S-5441). Parent CM-ORD-001, a reading: WooCommerce names it for the order (Order withdrawal), and a request that matches an order adds an order note (WC-S-5443); no statement puts it under returns and refunds. Salla's complaints platform, where the customer opens the complaint and Salla mediates (منصة الشكاوى, SA-C-178, domain A, which doesn't name D), isn't cited. Homonyms: Shopify's internal complaint-handling system and P2B and financial complaints (SH-C-177, SH-C-178, domain A) are merchants' complaints to Shopify; Salla's quality gateway (بوابة الجودة, SA-C-150, domain C) is the merchant's complaints about shipping companies; Shopify's disputes are payment chargebacks.

capability: Analytics and reports (Shopify Analytics; Salla Reports, Analytics / التقارير والتحليلات)
note: Q1's M-058. Shopify's admin route analytics, its navigation item, staff permissions, plan line and Admin API resource Analytics; Salla's dashboard app for /reports/analysis, its plan lines for analytics (sales, customers, visits, profits) and its app category Analytics (التحليل و الاحصاء). Children: reports (002), overview dashboards (003), Live View (004), smart analytics (005), and analytics through the API for apps (006).

capability: Reports (Shopify Reports; Salla Reports / التقارير)
note: Shopify's route analytics:reports, gated by the REPORTS permission (Analytics > Reports); Salla's link Reports (/reports), its dashboard app for its report pages, its settings route Statuses included in reports, its plan lines for reports and its staff permissions for each report. Salla's report types (sales, orders, customers, visits, loyalty, wishlists and others) are kinds of report, with permissions only, so they stay here. Shopify's plan line "200+ real-time reports, plus custom analytics" is cited in the parent.

capability: Overview dashboards and store performance (Shopify Overviews, Home; Salla Store performance / ملخص أداء المتجر)
note: Shopify's route analytics:overview gated by OVERVIEWS, and its staff permissions Analytics > Overviews, Home > Home and DASHBOARD; Salla's link Store performance (/reports/performance), its plan lines ملخص أداء المتجر and أداء المتجر, and its staff permissions for the home page's month and orders summaries and alerts. A join on role, a reading: neither platform defines an overview beyond its names.

capability: Live View (Shopify Live View)
note: Shopify's route analytics:live, gated by the store entitlement storefront, and its navigation item Live View. No statement defines it. Salla's cell is none-held.

capability: Smart analytics (Salla Smart analytics)
note: Salla's link Smart analytics (/reports/smart-analysis), not defined. Shopify's cell is none-held.

capability: Analytics and reports through the API for apps (Shopify ShopifyQL for analytics, read_reports; Salla Report Builder / Report Creator)
note: Shopify's API group ShopifyQL for analytics and the read_reports scope "so that your app can read analytics and reporting data" (SH-S-5905); Salla's API folders Report Builder, Report Types and APIs, and its Report Creator, which "enables developers to build custom analytical reports to be displayed on the Salla store dashboard" (SA-S-5146). A join on role, a reading: Salla's reports show in the store's dashboard; Shopify's statements don't say where an app's analytics show. Its parent is a reading: both name the store's analytics.

capability: Notifications: the messages the store sends automatically to customers and staff, with their settings and templates (Shopify Notifications, Customer notifications, Staff notifications; Salla Notifications / الإشعارات, اعدادات التنبيهات)
note: Q1's M-063 joins the two by the term Notifications. Shopify keeps its templates in Settings > Notifications (route notifications, its section Notifications); Salla's link Notifications (/notifications) and its staff permission store_notification_settings_management. Marketing messages are CM-MKT-007.

capability: Staff notifications: notices to the store's staff, such as of new orders (Shopify Staff notifications, Staff order notifications; Salla order_notification / تلقي إشعارات بالطلبات الجديدة)
note: Shopify's route notification-settings:staff is in its section Notifications (SH-S-5209), which puts it under CM-NTF-001. Salla gives it no place of its own: a staff permission in its Orders group (SA-C-040, domain C).

capability: Log of sent messages: the store's archive of the SMS it sent (Salla SMS log / أرشيف الرسائل النصية)
note: Salla puts it under its logs (/logs/messages), not under Notifications, so it has no parent. Shopify's statements hold no log of sent messages.

capability: Message delivery by SMS, email and WhatsApp, and the providers and communication apps that deliver it (Salla Communication Apps / تطبيق الاتصالات, SMS gateways, sender name, SMS balance)
note: Parent: a reading. Salla's Communication Webhooks name each message type a notification ("customer targeted by this notification", SA-S-1660), and a communication app "take[s] over message delivery" (SA-S-0192); the same apps also carry campaigns (CM-MKT-007) and sign-in codes (CM-CUS-010). Shopify's SMS and Email Services are Shopify Messaging's, in CM-MKT-007.

capability: B2B and wholesale selling: selling to business buyers at wholesale prices (Shopify B2B; Salla Wholesale market / سوق الجملة)
note: A join on role, a reading: Shopify sells to companies from the merchant's own store (blended or B2B-only); Salla's wholesale market is a channel (/channel/vendors) where the merchant lists products for retail merchants at special prices. Salla's buying side of the same market (vendors_buy_products) is domain B's CM-CAT-010.

capability: Companies: business buyers with their locations and contacts (Shopify Companies, company locations, company contacts)
note: Shopify's plan line puts company profiles under B2B (SH-S-7212); its admin puts Companies under Customers (staff permission Customers > Companies, SH-I-0928).

capability: Catalogs: product and price lists assigned to B2B buyers or markets (Shopify Catalogs; Salla special prices for retail merchants / تسعيرات خاصة لتجار التجزئة)
note: Parent: Shopify's plan row Shopify B2B counts catalogs ("Up to 3 catalogs", SH-S-7008) and its B2B page names "catalogs with wholesale pricing" (SH-S-7212). Its admin groups Catalogs under Markets (staff permission Markets > Catalogs, SH-I-0963), and its catalogs also serve retail and region markets (SH-S-5101): domain E's markets may cite them.

capability: Abandoned cart and order recovery: bringing back buyers who left without completing the order (WooCommerce Recovering orders)
note: WooCommerce gives it a Marketplace category of its own, Extensions > Conversion > Recovering orders (WC-S-0719), the dry run's test for a capability. Not defined in any WooCommerce statement held: a reading resting on the category's name. Shopify's Abandoned checkout recovery (SH-C-050, SH-S-7224) and Salla's استهداف السلات المتروكة, reminder messages to customers who left a cart (SA-C-048, SA-S-2099), are domain C in scope.tsv with D under also, so the back-fill may cite them here. No parent: no platform's grouping puts it under discounts or campaigns.

capability: Quotes: a business buyer's request for a quote, and the quote the store returns (BigCommerce B2B Edition Quotes, request-for-quote, Quoting & CPQ)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its B2B Edition API groups Quotes (management and storefront, the latter at rest/b2b/storefront/request-for-quote), webhook topics store/quote/* and the product line Quoting & CPQ. No statement defines a quote beyond these names; that the buyer requests it rests on the path request-for-quote, a reading. Under CM-B2B-001 because B2B Edition's scope store_b2b_manage names quotes among its data (BC-S-0196).

capability: Shopping lists: a business buyer's saved lists of products to order again (BigCommerce B2B Edition Shopping List, Requisition lists & reordering)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: B2B Edition's API groups Shopping List (management and storefront) and the product line Requisition lists & reordering. Not defined beyond these names. Close to CM-LOY-005 Wishlists (WooCommerce's shopper lists are cited there); kept apart because BigCommerce puts it in B2B Edition, beside its own Wishlist API (BC-S-0214), and names it for reordering. The reviewer may nest it.

capability: Sales reps for business buyers: the merchant's sales staff assigned to buyers' companies (BigCommerce B2B Edition Sales Staff, Super Admin, Sales rep ordering)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: B2B Edition's API groups Sales Staff and Super Admin (the storefront Super Admin group's path is rest/b2b/storefront/sales-rep), the webhook topics store/superadmin/* and store/company/superadmin/assignmentUpdated, and the product line Sales rep ordering. That a Super Admin is a sales rep rests on that path, a reading; what a sales rep may do for a company isn't stated.

capability: Buyer portal: the business buyer's own part of the storefront (BigCommerce Buyer portal, B2B Edition Storefront APIs)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: the product line Buyer portal and B2B Edition's Storefront API group (rest/b2b/storefront). Neither is defined in a statement held: that the Storefront APIs serve the buyer portal is a reading on the names. The reviewer may fold it into CM-B2B-001, or nest it with CM-CUS-010 Customer accounts.

capability: Product recommendations: products the platform recommends to buyers on the storefront (BigCommerce Product Recommendations, Google Vertex AI)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its API group Beta Product Recommendations, recommendations generated through Google Vertex AI and queried by the GraphQL Storefront API, in closed beta on Enterprise plans. Kept apart from CM-MKT-021 Upsell and cross-sell offers: no statement of any platform defines upsell or cross-sell, and none calls BigCommerce's recommendations either. The reviewer may nest them.

capability: Commerce data sent to outside analytics platforms and data warehouses (BigCommerce Big Open Data Solutions)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its product line Big Open Data Solutions, which 'Connect[s] commerce data to BigQuery and leading analytics platforms including Tableau, Power BI, and Looker' (BC-S-0336). A place of its own (a product line), so not folded into CM-ANL-001. Kept apart from CM-ANL-006, which is apps reading the platform's reports through its API: BODS sends the store's data out to named platforms. Under CM-ANL-001 because BigCommerce's statement places it with analytics platforms and Q1 put it in BC-C-062 Reporting and analytics; no statement groups the product line under another, so the parent is a reading.

capability: Customer referral programme: each customer gets a referral code, and both the customer and the friend they invite are rewarded when the friend orders (Zid: Customer referrals / برنامج دعوات العملاء)
note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (ZD-1 and its review, 30 October). Zid gives it an admin route of its own (marketing/referrals, and marketing/referrals/program in its route manifest), which its marketing page files under loyalty and rewards (the review's R5a); its sidebar badge is beta. Not CM-MKT-013 or CM-MKT-014, affiliates who promote the store for a commission, nor CM-PTN-008, the referral of the platform's own plans.

capability: Online store and its theme (Shopify: Online Store, Themes and templates; Salla: Store design, تصميم واجهة المتجر, اختيار ثيم المتجر)
note: The root of the storefront tree. Shopify's Online Store section (admin navigation OnlineStore, route online-store) and Salla's Store design (/themes, dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-themes) each hold the store's theme, its editor, the theme market and, on Salla, the landing pages. "Online store" names the whole storefront on Shopify; Salla has no separate term for it, its plan line تصميم واجهة المتجر names the storefront's design.

capability: Theme editor and theme code (Shopify: theme editor, Edit code, Liquid, write_theme_code; Salla: themes editor, تخصيص الثيم عبر CSS و JS, Twilight Engine)
note: Customizing the published theme without code (editor) and with code (Shopify's Liquid and Edit code; Salla's CSS and JS customization and Twilight themes). Both platforms put it under the theme section: Shopify's staff permission "Online store > Edit code" and route editor; Salla's /themes/editor.

capability: Theme marketplace (Shopify: Theme Store; Salla: Theme Marketplace / متجر الثيمات)
note: Where merchants find and buy themes made by designers or developers, and where those makers publish them. Shopify's Theme Store; Salla's Theme Marketplace (/themes/marketplace) and its partners' theme publication. Salla's partner side (SA-C-208) lands in batch 2.

capability: App extensions in the storefront (Shopify: theme app extensions, app embeds, app proxies, script tags; Salla: App Snippets)
note: How an installed app adds its own elements or code to the merchant's storefront. Shopify: "Theme app extensions allow merchants to easily add dynamic elements to their themes" (SH-S-0705); Salla: "App Snippet lets you extend any merchant store with custom JavaScript" (SA-S-0209). Under CM-SFR-001 because Shopify's statement puts it in the theme.

capability: Storefront design elements beyond the theme (Shopify: Store design apps; Salla: Component Bundle)
note: Elements added to the storefront's design besides the theme itself: Shopify's App Store category Store design apps (page builders, content, design elements, media, banners, pop-ups, product display, site optimization); Salla's component bundles published in its Theme Marketplace. Shopify's SEO apps sit in that category too; SEO is area CNT and its cell is left to that batch.

capability: Landing pages and page builders (Shopify: Page builder apps; Salla: Landing pages / صفحات هبوط المنتج)
note: Pages built outside the theme's templates for a product or a campaign. Salla builds them itself (/themes/landing-pages); Shopify's statements show only the App Store category Page builder apps. The join is on role, a reading. Salla's plan places صفحات هبوط المنتج under أدوات التسويق (adoat-altsoyk) and its admin under themes.

capability: Storefront announcement bars, banners and pop-ups (Shopify: Banner apps, Pop-up apps; Salla: Advertisements / شريط إعلاني أعلى المتجر)
note: A bar, banner or pop-up shown across the storefront. Salla builds a top bar itself (Advertisements, under /marketing); Shopify's statements show only the App Store categories Banner apps and Pop-up apps under Store design apps. The parent follows Shopify's grouping; Salla's admin puts Advertisements under marketing (SA-S-3536). "Advertisements" on Salla is not Salla Ads (إعلانات سلة, SA-C-073), its ad-campaign product.

capability: Store domains (Shopify: Domains, Custom domain name; Salla: Domain, حجز دومين خاص)
note: The store's own domain name: buying one through the platform, connecting or transferring one from another provider, and the platform's default domain. Joined by Q1's match M-017. Salla's Partners-portal domains (SA-C-301) land in batch 2.

capability: DNS records for the store domain (Salla: DNS Records, إدارة إعدادات DNS)
note: Managing the DNS records of the store's domain from the platform. Salla gives it an API group (DNS Records), an access scope (dns-records) and a plan line under its domain feature. Shopify's statements hold nothing under the terms searched, and don't define it.

capability: SSL certificate for the store's domains (Shopify: Free SSL certificate, sslEnabled; Salla: شهادة SSL مجانية)
note: The store's domains served over an SSL certificate. Under CM-SFR-008 because both platforms put the SSL certificate with the domain: Salla's plan line شهادة SSL مجانية has parent_code domyn-almtgr (SA-S-2038), Shopify's sslEnabled is a field of Domain (SH-S-7465). Hosting of the store is G's CM-OPS-003, where Shopify's plan row Unlimited web hosting (SH-S-7032) is core; it was here with SSL because Shopify's concern holds both, and is moved out so it counts once (the coordinator, after batch 1).

capability: Headless and custom storefronts (Shopify: Headless, Hydrogen, Oxygen, Build headless storefronts)
note: A storefront the merchant or a developer builds apart from the platform's themes, on the platform's commerce data. Shopify gives it admin routes (headless, hydrogen), a plan line and its own hosting (Oxygen).

capability: Storefront API (Shopify: Storefront API; Salla: Store APIs, storefront APIs)
note: The buyer-facing API a storefront calls for products, cart, customers and content. Under CM-SFR-011 by Shopify's grouping, whose headless concern holds it (Headless channel or custom app, SH-S-6152); on Salla the storefront APIs are called by Twilight themes through the Twilight JS SDK (SA-S-5140), so Salla's grouping differs: see notes. Salla's SA-C-101 lands in batch 2 (M-056).

capability: Storefront search and filtering (Shopify: Search, Filters, read_discovery; Salla: Product filter settings, إدارة خيارات التصفية الظاهرة للعميل)
note: The buyer's search and the product filters shown on the storefront. Salla's filters sit in its products concern SA-C-020 (domain B, naming E under also).

capability: Files (Shopify: Files, Content > Files)
note: The store's library of uploaded files. Shopify gives it a place of its own: admin navigation Files under Content (SH-S-1525), the route file:list gated by VIEW_FILES (SH-S-5122), the scopes read_files and write_files. No Salla statement found names a store-wide file library (searched; see the Salla cell).

capability: Custom data: metafields and metaobjects (Shopify: Metafields and metaobjects, custom data)
note: Merchant-defined fields and objects on the store's data. Shopify gives it a settings page (Metafields and metaobjects, SH-S-1500), admin navigation Metaobjects, scopes, webhook topics and staff permissions. Salla's custom fields (product custom fields, SA-C-020; order custom fields, SA-C-042) are not joined: neither side defines its term, and the terms differ (Q1's U-005; see the notes).

capability: Store pages (Shopify: Pages, Blog posts and pages; Salla: Information pages, الصفحات التعريفية)
note: Pages of content on the storefront. Shopify's grouping holds the blog under pages: the staff permission Online store > Blog posts and pages (SH-I-0991), the PAGES permission on the blog's comments route (SH-S-5124), and the scope read_online_store_pages on article events (SH-S-6062). Salla's grouping differs: information pages at /channel/pages (SA-S-1831), the blog at /blog and /marketing/blog (SA-S-1698, SA-S-3555). The parent follows Shopify's, the one grouping that joins them.

capability: Store blog (Shopify: Blog, Blog posts; Salla: Blog, مدونة المتجر)
note: A blog of posts on the storefront. Shopify: Blog posts in Content (SH-S-1527), the Article and Blog resources. Salla: Blog (/blog, SA-S-1698), its settings, plan line and staff permissions. Under CM-CNT-003 by Shopify's grouping (see CM-CNT-003's note); Salla puts its blog under marketing.

capability: Navigation menus (Shopify: Menus; Salla: store-menu)
note: The storefront's navigation menus. Shopify: Menus in Content (SH-S-1526), gated by LINKS (SH-S-5123), scopes read and write_online_store_navigation. Salla: the released dashboard flag store-menu (SA-S-3343). Shopify's URL redirects, in its concern SH-C-031, have no statement of their own (see the notes).

capability: Custom URLs (Salla: Custom URLs, روابط مخصصة)
note: Salla's Custom URLs: an admin link (/manage/custom-urls), an API folder, a plan line and a staff permission. No statement defines what a custom URL is. Not joined with Shopify's URL redirects: Q1's M-015 note says the terms differ, and Shopify's redirects have no statement of their own.

capability: SEO (Salla: SEO, تحسين ظهور المتجر على محركات البحث; Shopify: SEO apps)
note: Optimizing the store for search engines. Salla builds it (SEO at /marketing/seo, an API folder, plan lines, flags and staff permissions) and has an app category Site Optimization; Shopify's statements show only the App Store category SEO apps (SH-I-1934, an entry Q1 placed in SH-C-193, landed in CM-SFR-005).

capability: Store policies (Shopify: Policies, Store policies; Salla: information pages for the store's policies, سياساتك)
note: The store's published policies (refund, return, shipping, terms). Shopify: Settings > Policies (SH-S-7087), gated by MANAGE_POLICIES and the policies entitlement. Salla: no policies section; its information pages carry the policies (SA-S-2100), and one is marked as the return and exchange policy page (SA-S-5034). A join on role. A root by Shopify's grouping (Settings, not Content); on Salla the policies are information pages (CM-CNT-003).

capability: Sales channels and publishing to them (Shopify: Sales channels, publications; Salla: Sales channels / قنوات البيع, product.publish)
note: Q1's M-054. Both platforms give it an admin place of its own: Shopify's Sales channels (SH-S-1534, SH-S-1496), Salla's Sales channels (/channels, SA-S-1687). Its children are the channels and channel tools the platforms put under it (see notes).

capability: The platform's own shopping app or marketplace for buyers (Shopify: Shop, Shop App; Salla: Mahally / منصة محلي)
note: A join on role (U-053): Shop, "a shopping destination ... available to customers" (SH-S-0723), against Mahally, "a discovery and sales channel connected to Salla merchants" (SA-S-0005). Parent: Shopify's help puts Shop under online-sales-channels (SH-S-0723's identifier); Salla's plan puts منصة محلي under its sales-channels group knoat-albyaa (SA-S-2067).

capability: Connecting external marketplaces and syncing their orders (Shopify: Marketplace Connect, marketplace orders; Salla: الربط بمنصات التسوّق العالمية)
note: A join on role (U-054). Parent: Shopify's help puts Marketplace Connect under online-sales-channels/marketplaces (SH-S-0727's identifier); Salla's plan line is in its sales channels concern (SA-C-097).

capability: Product listings and feeds for channels (Shopify: Listings, product_listings, product_feeds; Salla: google-merchant-feed, facebook-catalog-feed, snapchat-catalog-feed)
note: Q1's M-055 holds Shopify's feeds with pixels and events (domain D); scope.tsv places SH-C-138 here apart from it. A root: no held statement puts listings or feeds under sales channels on either platform; Salla's feed flags sit in its Pixels & feeds concern (SA-C-074, domain D, under marketing).

capability: Selling and sourcing products between the platform's stores (Shopify: Shopify Collective)
note: Shopify's alone so far: its plan row Sell and source products with Shopify Collective (SH-S-7013). Parent: Shopify's help puts it under online-sales-channels (SH-S-0729's identifier). Domain B's CM-CAT-010 (product sourcing) also cites SH-S-0729 and SH-S-7013 as core.

capability: The store's own branded mobile app (Shopify: Mobile app builder apps, mobile platform applications; Salla: App Maker / صانع التطبيقات, Mobile app)
note: Q1's M-078: built in on Salla, through apps on Shopify. Parent by Salla's grouping: route /channel/mobile (SA-S-1837) and the plan line صانع التطبيقات under knoat-albyaa (SA-S-2068); Shopify's statements show no grouping for it.

capability: Point of sale: in-person selling from the platform's own POS app (Shopify: Point of Sale, Shopify POS, POS Pro, Retail; Salla: Salla Point / سلة بوينت, Free Cashier, نقاط البيع)
note: Q1's M-057. Both platforms give it a place of its own: Shopify's plan rows Casual, in-person sales and POS Pro (SH-S-7017, SH-S-7018), its terms' 9.3 POS Services and its POS app; Salla's admin link Salla PointFree Cashier (/channel/sallapoint, SA-S-1836), its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-pos (SA-S-3540), its plan line and its staff permission group سلة بوينت. Parent CM-CHN-001, a reading: both platforms' admin identifiers name it a channel, Salla's route /channel/sallapoint beside /channel/mahally and /channel/mobile, Shopify's admin route apps/point-of-sale-channel (SH-C-086/where/SH-S-6329, domain C naming E) and its retail role permission view_payment_tracking_sessions_pos_channel (SH-C-087/boundary/SH-S-5941). Against it: Shopify's help keeps sell-in-person apart from online-sales-channels, and Salla's plan group knoat-albyaa doesn't list Salla Point (see notes). Parent of CM-POS-002, CM-POS-003 and CM-POS-004.

capability: POS hardware and card-present payment devices (Shopify: POS Equipment, Shopify Hardware Store; Salla: جهاز الدفع, Terminal ID, card payment in the Salla Point cashier, SoftPOS)
note: The device that takes the buyer's card at the point of sale. Shopify gives it a place of its own: the Shopify Hardware Store (SH-S-7270), the POS Equipment Agreement and Return Policies (SH-I-1398) and the help section Hardware for Shopify POS (SH-I-2299). Joined on role with Salla's payment terminal in Salla Point, a reading (U-074): Shopify sells equipment to accept Card Present Transactions (SH-S-7269); Salla's card payment runs on the merchant's own phone or tablet (SA-S-2094), with a terminal ID from Geidea or NearPay assigned to one device (SA-S-5040, SA-S-5042). The card payment's processing and rates are domain C's (SH-C-086).

capability: Cash management at the point of sale (Shopify: cash tracking, cash drawers, read_cash_tracking, write_cash_tracking)
note: Shopify gives it an API scope pair of its own, read_cash_tracking and write_cash_tracking, whose queries also need a POS retail role permission (SH-S-5941). Salla's Salla Point shift permissions (بدء وإنهاء الشفت, عرض تقارير الشفتات) name shifts, not cash, and are cited in CM-POS-001; no Salla statement says a shift counts cash (see notes).

capability: App extensions in the POS app (Shopify: POS UI extensions, pos_action, POS block, POS smart grid)
note: Shopify's extension targets inside its POS app (SH-S-0713, SH-S-2217, the pos.* targets SH-I-1666 to SH-I-1696). Parent CM-POS-001 by Shopify's own grouping: "Extending Shopify POS with UI extensions" (SH-S-0713). scope.tsv gives SH-C-144 domain E naming F, so domain F's CM-APP tree, such as Admin UI extensions (CM-APP-008), may cite it.

capability: Markets: per-country or per-region versions of the store's selling (Shopify: Markets, Shopify Markets, Localized selling with Shopify Markets; Salla: Markets / الأسواق المتعددة, Store Scopes, multi-countries)
note: The root of the markets tree. Shopify's Markets (admin route markets, staff permissions VIEW_MARKETS, CREATE_AND_EDIT_MARKETS, read_markets and write_markets, markets webhooks, plan row Localized selling with Shopify Markets) and Salla's Markets (settings markets, Store Scopes API, multi-countries flags, help page الأسواق المتعددة). Both define it as a customized experience of the store for the buyers of a place: Shopify by location, customer group, retail location or sales channel; Salla per country, region or city. Shopify's backup region, a setting every store must have for Markets, is held here: it has no place of its own (its route is Settings > General).

capability: Rollouts: scheduled changes to the live store (Shopify: Rollouts, rollouts/create, read_rollouts; Salla: جدولة نشر النسخ, scheduling the publishing of theme versions)
note: Shopify's Rollouts has its own admin route, entitlement, scope and webhooks; a rollout is a scheduled set of changes to the main theme, checkout and accounts pages, discounts or product catalogs. The parent follows Shopify's grouping: its help puts rollouts under manual/markets and its staff permissions under Markets > Catalogs. Salla's side is a plan line under store design, narrower (theme versions only): a join on role.

capability: Merchant of record for cross-border selling (Shopify: Managed Markets, powered by Global-e; Salla: المدفوعات و البيع بالنيابة (MoR), in its global selling programme for partners)
note: A third party becomes the merchant of record for the store's sales abroad, handling payments, taxes and duties. Shopify's Managed Markets is under Markets (route managed in section Markets); Salla's is a service listed on its partners' global selling programme page, whose capability in domain F is CM-PTN-007. Joined on role, a reading.

capability: Local domains and visitor geolocation: sending each market's buyers to its domain, country and currency (Shopify: Assign local domains, MarketWebPresence, Geolocation apps, country selector; Salla: the currency shown by the customer's geographic location)
note: Shopify's market web presence (a domain or subfolder per market, which defines its SEO strategy), its plan row Assign local domains, its Geolocation apps category and its country selector. Homonym: Salla's app category Geolocation / الموقع الجغرافي is map services for customer addresses (CM-CUS-009, domain D), not this.

capability: Store currency: the store's default currency (Shopify: store currency, Shop.currencyCode; Salla: العملة الافتراضية in the store's settings)

I put the capability under apps, which its events are about, and not under the partner programme, whose capability doesn't exist yet in this part (notes).

note: M-070, one to one. Shopify's functions customize its backend logic and Shopify invokes them within the customer journey, never by URL (SH-S-0681, SH-S-0683); Salla's run when events occur in a store, fully managed by Salla, some of them synchronous and blocking (SA-S-0187, SA-S-0190, SA-S-0189). capability: Access scopes: the parts of a store's data an app may read or write, which the merchant grants (Shopify access scopes; Salla App Scope)

note: Shopify only so far.

note: M-069. Parent of CM-API-009 to CM-API-011. The topics on an app's own lifecycle are CM-APP-004's.

note: Salla's place: the Partners portal link Ready Stores, /store (SA-S-1932). What a ready store holds, and who buys it, isn't stated beyond its review (SA-S-5111).

Homonym: Shopify's "commerce agents" (SH-S-0714) act on behalf of buyers, in CM-AIA-005, not this.

capability: AI content generation: text the platform's AI writes for the merchant, such as product descriptions, blog posts and SEO fields (Shopify Magic; Salla ai-description-generator, ai-seo-generator, توليد تحسينات SEO عبر الذكاء الاصطناعي)
note: Shopify Magic generates product descriptions and blog posts in the product and article editors (SH-S-7203, SH-S-7204, SH-S-7206, SH-S-7207); Salla's flags ai-description-generator and ai-seo-generator are unreleased (SA-S-3488, SA-S-3489), and its plan line generates SEO improvements with AI for an extra fee (SA-S-2133, plan سلة برو). Salla's SEO plan line and ai-seo-generator are also statements of SA-C-033 (SEO, domain E); the cells cite SA-C-012's keys.

capability: AI connector: linking an outside AI assistant to the store through an MCP server the platform provides (Salla AI Connector, salla-mcp)
note: Only Salla shows it so far: the setting Salla AI Connector (general/salla-mcp, SA-S-1725), whose ChatGPT step lets the merchant add a custom MCP server from Salla (SA-S-5005), and the released flag salla-mcp (SA-S-3188). Who the connected assistant acts for is not stated. Under CM-AIA-001 because its setting is in the merchant's own settings (a reading). Kept apart from Shopify's UCP-compliant MCP servers, which serve agents acting on behalf of buyers (SH-S-0714, CM-AIA-005): the shared term MCP doesn't show the same object (notes). Q1's M-079 joins it with WooCommerce MCP.

capability: Agentic commerce: buyers discovering and buying a store's products through AI chats and agents, on channels the platform or third parties operate (Shopify Agentic Storefronts, Sell in AI chats, Universal Commerce Protocol, Agentic)
note: Only Shopify shows it so far: Agentic Storefronts "enables buyers to discover and purchase products from eligible merchants from the user interface of certain channels operated by Shopify or third party Shopify partners" (SH-S-0621), the plan line Sell in AI chats (SH-S-7007), the admin's Agentic section at apps/agentic (SH-S-5027), and the Universal Commerce Protocol with Shopify's UCP-compliant MCP servers for commerce agents (SH-S-0714, SH-S-2530). Salla's only UCP term is the unreleased flag ucp-embedded-checkout of SA-C-100 (domain C, without F under also), left uncited (notes).

capability: Apps made by the platform's company: extensions the platform's company makes, sells and supports, in a category of its own in the platform's marketplace (WooCommerce Developed by Woo, Woo extensions)
note: WooCommerce gives it a marketplace category of its own, Extensions > Developed by Woo (WC-C-050/where/WC-S-0697), the dry run's test for a capability. Its parent is CM-APP-002 because the category sits under the Marketplace's Extensions (the category's own path). Shopify's apps made by Shopify (SH-C-156/responsible/SH-S-0738, cited as shows in CM-APP-001) are for the back-fill to read.

capability: Marketplace connection: linking the store to the platform's marketplace account, so that the merchant installs extensions from it, receives their updates and support, and manages their subscriptions from the admin (WooCommerce Connection to WooCommerce.com, Advanced > WooCommerce.com, wccom-site/v3)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section (Advanced > WooCommerce.com, WC-S-0027) and an API group (wccom-site/v3, WC-S-0085) of their own. A store the platform hosts, as on Shopify and Salla, may need no such link; whether the anchors show one is for the back-fill.

capability: API response caching: the platform caches its API's responses, under a setting of its own (WooCommerce Advanced > REST API caching, rest_api_caching)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section of its own (WC-S-0024). Its feature flag is experimental and off by default (WC-S-5414).

capability: Account-level API: the platform's API over the merchant's account rather than one store, reaching all the account's stores and its control panel users, with credentials and scopes of its own (BigCommerce GraphQL Account API, Account API, account-level API credentials, account_* scopes)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Account API [graphql], BC-I-0109) beside the store-level Admin API. Parent CM-API-001 because BigCommerce lists it among its API accounts (BC-S-0302: store-level, app-level and account-level credentials).

capability: Staging environments: environments where a store's updates are tested and previewed, then deployed, without disrupting the live storefront (BigCommerce Staging environments, StagingPro)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: a product line of its own (BC-I-0540). Not a development store (CM-DVT-004): it stages a live store's changes, not a free store for building apps and themes. No parent: no statement groups it under the developer tools.

capability: Commerce-as-a-Service for partners: partner APIs through which a partner offers the platform's stores to its own merchants, creates and onboards them, changes their plans, and may own their billing (BigCommerce Powered By, Beta Powered By, Commerce-as-a-Service)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Beta Powered By, BC-I-0115) and a product line. Not partner stores (CM-DVT-003): the stores are the partner's merchants' live stores, which the partner resells.

capability: Import and export of store data: products, customers and orders (Salla Import & export / إدارة الاستيراد والتصدير, Exports / التصدير; Shopify product imports and the Export permissions)
note: Parent of CM-MIG-002 and CM-MIG-003. Neither platform keeps one section for import and export: Salla puts each object's import or export in that object's list (products, customers, orders) and holds them under one staff permission, import_export_management, one flag, impex, and one Merchant API folder, Exports; Shopify puts its product import routes in Products and an Export permission under each object's section. The objects are named in the cells' readings, not split into capabilities, since each object's section belongs to another domain. Homonyms kept out: customs import and export (duties, export control), the export of a customer's personal data (privacy), marketplace order import (channels).

capability: Advanced import (Salla Advanced import / الاستيراد المتقدم, its custom importer)
note: Salla gives it its own link, route and dashboard app (/importer) and permissions apart from import_export_management. The parent is by its own name, an import (إدارة الاستيراد المتقدم), listed in the products list beside Import & export. Salla doesn't say what it imports or how it differs from Import & export.

capability: Export templates (Salla Export templates, for products and orders)
note: Salla's own links put the templates at the products' and orders' exports routes (/products/exports, /orders/exports). What a template holds isn't stated.

capability: Export log: the record of a store's exports (Salla Export log / سجل التصدير)
note: No parent: Salla's route puts it under its logs (/logs/export), beside Activity history (SA-C-010, domain A's audit log), which a parent in this domain can't follow. Homonym: Salla's سجل names both this export log and the activity log (سجل العمليات), and Q1 lists logs as audit logs against system logs (U-044); this capability is neither.

capability: Moving a store from another platform (Salla's store migration service / خدمة انتقال المتاجر من منصات أخرى; Shopify's migrating from QuickBooks Desktop POS)
note: Salla keeps the service apart from import and export: it has its own terms, eligibility, benefits and contracting company. No platform statement puts it under import and export, so it has no parent.

capability: Platform reliability and continuity: staying available under load, through failures, and when a partner fails (Salla استقرار المنصة وجاهزيتها للذروة; Shopify pods and recovery sites)
note: Joined on role, a reading: Salla sells platform stability and readiness for peak as a plan line, and Shopify's engineering statements describe isolated pods, each with a recovery site. Neither defines the term. What happens when a partner fails (SA-C-235) sits here because no platform gives it a place of its own (convention 2); its statements are each about one kind of partner.

capability: Service status page (Salla's status page)
note: Salla's status page lists components with their state (Merchant APIs; Store APIs, SA-C-101, is domain E's). The concern map holds no Shopify status page.

capability: Export and import of store configuration (WooCommerce Blueprint)
note: Its own section under Settings > Advanced, 'Blueprint (beta)' (WC-S-0028), with its own export route (WC-S-5451) and import checks (WC-S-5448, WC-S-5449). Its imports can change settings (WC-S-5450), so it is about the store's configuration, not the products, customers and orders of CM-MIG-001; no statement puts it under import and export, so it has no parent. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Hosting of the store: the environment the store runs on (WooCommerce hosting environment, hosting provider)
note: WooCommerce's Server Recommendations page asks the merchant to verify their hosting environment (WC-S-0642), and its privacy policy names 'your hosting provider if your site is not hosted by Automattic' (WC-S-0503). Not CM-OPS-001 (reliability and continuity). A lead for the back-fill: Shopify's plan line Unlimited web hosting (SH-C-036/decides/SH-S-7032; SH-C-036 is domain E and names G under also). WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Store status: the system status report and tools (WooCommerce Status: System status, Tools)
note: WooCommerce's admin page WooCommerce > Status, with its tabs System status and Tools, and its own system-status and system-status-tools REST APIs (WC-S-0045, WC-S-0036, WC-S-0037, WC-S-0120, WC-S-0121). Homonym: not CM-OPS-002, the platform's service status page; 'status' names the store's own report here. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Store logs: the entries the store's logger records (WooCommerce Logs)
note: Under CM-OPS-004 by WooCommerce's own grouping: the Logs tab is under Status ('WooCommerce > Status > Logs', WC-S-0920; WC-S-0038). Homonym: not an audit log of staff activity (Shopify's MerchantAuditLog, Salla's Activity history, domain A; U-044), and not Salla's Export log (CM-MIG-004). WooCommerce's Remote Logging, which sends error logs to WooCommerce, lands here strained. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Feature settings: features the merchant enables or disables, experimental ones included (WooCommerce Features)
note: Its own section, Features, under Settings > Advanced (WC-S-5432), defined by WooCommerce as 'the WooCommerce features that can be enabled and disabled by admin users' (WC-S-5433), each definition with is_experimental and enabled_by_default (WC-S-5434). The anchor read Shopify's betas and Salla's released flags as scoping the features they gate, not as capabilities; they are leads for the back-fill to read against this definition. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Mobile app for managing the store, with push notifications (WooCommerce mobile app)
note: WooCommerce's onboarding task 'Get the free WooCommerce mobile app' (WC-S-0422), its push notifications setting for the mobile apps (WC-S-0939) and its mobile-app API routes (WC-S-0203, WC-S-0204). Push notifications are one feature flag (WC-S-5437), not a place of their own, so they stay in this capability. A lead for the back-fill: Salla's plan line تطبيق إدارة المتجر على أجهزة iOS و Android (SA-C-001/decides/SA-S-2082; SA-C-001 is domain A and doesn't name G under also; U-068). WooCommerce only so far.
